summary.text: The Calamity Beasts are fearsome natural-disaster creatures of Bloomburrow, heralds of seasonal and chaotic change, such as the Blight Snake, Drought Cat and Spring Elk.

bio.text: Helga sees that her drawing resembles a Calamity Beast and resolves to show it to Iver.

status.text: The latest recorded event is Helga recognizing that her drawing resembles a Calamity Beast; the material records nothing further.
